raw_record.question_text: Two rectangles with measurements $8 \times 10$ and $9 \times 12$ overlap to some extent. The dark grey area is 37. What is the area of the light grey part?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as two overlapping rectangles: the lower-left rectangle has dimensions 10 by 8, the upper-right rectangle has dimensions 12 by 9, and the central white rectangular region is their shared overlap. The dark grey part is the portion of the 10 by 8 rectangle outside the overlap. From the text, the dark grey area is 37. Compute the full area of the smaller rectangle, 10×8=80, so the overlap area is 80−37=43. Then compute the full area of the larger rectangle, 12×9=108, and subtract the same overlap to get the light grey part: 108−43=65.
